source.name: CEFR-J Wordlist
source.citation: The CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.5. Compiled by Yukio Tono, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies.
source.terms: Free for research and commercial use, provided the dataset is cited.
source.selection: Levels A1-B1; closed-class rows (determiner, modal auxiliary, be-/do-/have-verb, infinitive-to) left out.
source.topics: topicSource "threshold": the Threshold column of the source; "threshold-sibling": same headword, another part of speech; "llm": classified once, offline, into the same topics (review by sampling).
source.collections: CoreInventory 1 / CoreInventory 2 columns of the source as snake_case keys (e.g. "Work and Jobs" -> work_jobs): browsing tags only, never a topic or concept.
